locked_context.purpose: inform voters, build confidence in the system; credible/neutral
locked_context.timeline: launch in days; agents run non-stop

questions.q: Working name + domain?
Confirm tool is method-neutral + fully sourced; lean lives only in outreach framing.
Adopt VC-style disclaimer ('educational, not how-to-vote')?
Confirm v1 = party-level only. Target launch date?
Question count for v1?
v1 features: questionnaire + 2-D compass + alignment bars + per-question citations; EN only; mobile-first; WCAG AA; no demographics.
Scoring: code parties -2..+2 per statement; pre-assign dimensions; alignment = normalised similarity; IRT later.
Dimensions: economy/taxes x social (VC-style) or BC-specific axes?
Issue-importance weighting in v1?
Human coding gate: 2 independent coders + adversarial agent, human tie-break, human sign-off before publish.
Send parties self-coding request without blocking launch?
Party list: NDP, Conservative, Green, OneBC, CentreBC; minors by rule.
Adopt VC source-priority ladder?
Provenance: quoting snippet + archived URL + hash per coding.
Riding data: Elections BC + StatCan postal->riding; recode weekly + on platform release, versioned.
Stack: static site, in-repo JSON, browser-side scoring, no DB, no PII.
Public GitHub, permissive license (MIT?), PR review (agents + human); hosting preference (Cloudflare/Vercel/Netlify/VPS)?
Privacy/legal: PIPEDA/FIPPA-safe, no PII, disclaimer page.
Orchestration layers: recon -> coding -> adversarial QA -> build -> integration; human gates on codings + publish.
Outreach: which media partners + influencers/communities? Who writes the pitch?
Success metric targets (completions, shares, press pickups)?
